scope: Appendix B reduced two-level feasibility estimate only. This is not a driven multichannel gate simulation, gate design, or process-fidelity result.

model.screening_sequence: square Rb pi, Yb 2pi, Rb pi
model.screening_metric: local-Z-corrected loss-aware Haar-average formula applied only to the surviving computational block of the reduced surrogate
model.distance_interpolation: PCHIP through calculated U(R), w(R); guide only

provenance.solver: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh, 24 eigenpairs around the previous branch shift while stepping from R=5 to 3 micrometers
provenance.magnetic_basis: all individual atomic magnetic sublevels; only total pair M fixed

zero_field_c6.method: second-order A^dagger V (E0-H0)^-1 V A at R=1 micrometer; all individual magnetic sublevels retained and only total M fixed

configuration.branch_selection: largest bare-product weight among eigenpairs centered on the preceding branch shift
configuration.shift_definition: selected eigenenergy minus same-field dressed pair asymptote

r6_deviation_summary.definition: U_dense - C6/R^6 using the zero-field C6 guide
